text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Aww, the dance in this MV is so cuuute!
I wanna do it too~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I'll dance super cute~,
and make Trainy give me lots of headpats! ♡"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Mmuuuh, I can't accept this...!
I know I can dance way cuter than that~!
However, no matter how many times she danced, she couldn't reach a satisfying level... leaving her completely exhausted, body and soul.
